verdict.rationale: Phaser's primary language is JavaScript/TypeScript, with full TypeScript definitions and editor IntelliSense/VSCode auto-detection cited (phaser-docs-4, phaser-docs-33, phaser-docs-39), and since it's a plain JS/TS library the entire engine API is exposed and standard JS/TS debuggers (browser devtools, VSCode) naturally apply. However, there's no explicit documentation of a dedicated debugger tool/integration, and community evidence notes TypeScript support is only a 'best-effort' DefinitelyTyped layer rather than native (phaser-comm-12) and criticizes documentation quality repeatedly (phaser-comm-3, phaser-comm-5, phaser-comm-17), undercutting the 'fully exposes the API' claim. Missing for 10: explicit debugger documentation/tooling, native (non-DefinitelyTyped) TypeScript integration, and stronger docs-quality corroboration.
